_comment: The wording of each alert a run sends to the reader's channels. `headline` opens the subject, which run_digest finishes with the period and the minute the run started. `text` is the body; where it has {status} or {detail}, the run fills them. English, like every user-facing string here.

vote_similarity_rejected.headline: Vote similarity did not run
vote_similarity_rejected.text: Vote similarity did not run this period, so reader votes had no effect on this digest. The digest was published unfiltered. The embedding API refused the request: HTTP {status} {detail}. This repeats every run until the embedding key or its permissions are fixed.
